title: How Many?
objective: Counting a group accurately answers "how many," and the last count word said names the size of the whole group (cardinality).
newIdea: Cardinality — the last number counted is the answer, not just the last object touched.

teaching.setup: A small group of objects (4-6) is shown, unlabeled.
teaching.see: What do we want to know? How many are here?
teaching.break: Touch and count each object once, in any order.
teaching.build: The last word said is announced as the group's total.
teaching.transform: Count the same group again in a different order — same total.

check.prompt: Recount once more; does it still come out the same?

examples.transfer: 7 objects the learner has not counted before.

mastery.evidence: Counts a group of 5-7 objects correctly twice in a row, in a different order each time.
